items.html: Now you find that the bottom four de Beria and the entire Olam Yetzira and Assiya which are the place of twenty-four Sefirot were then all vacant, empty and Halal. It was in the form of Shabbat Zone, which is two thousand Amah except for the last fourteen Sefirot, which became a permanent section for the Klipot. The other ten Upper Sefirot were in the form of Shabbat Zone.
